title: OpenClaw Habit Tracking: Automate Daily Check-Ins, Streaks, and Weekly Reports
summary: OpenClaw habit tracking: set up HEARTBEAT.md check-ins, streak tracking, and weekly reports. Your AI agent logs habits 24/7 — no app to remember to open.
body_markdown: Yes. Message your agent directly: "I want to start tracking water intake — 8 glasses a day. Check in at 4pm." The agent adds it immediately for the current session. For persistent scheduled check-ins across sessions, add the habit to HEARTBEAT.md. Both methods log data to the same habit-tracker storage.
